mapper.sql: (SELECT U.TEAM_SN FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId})
(P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN = OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PTCP_TEAM PT WHERE PT.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND PT.TEAM_SN = ))

P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, P.PBANC_STTS_CD AS statusCd, S.CD_NM AS statusNm, R.CD_NM AS returnNm, TM.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ddlnText, TRUNC(P.BID_DDLN_DT) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS dday

FROM TB_BID_PBANC P LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD S ON S.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND S.CD = P.PBANC_STTS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD R ON R.GROUP_CD = 'RTRSE' AND R.CD = P.RTRN_SE_CD LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM TM ON TM.TEAM_SN = P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS010' AND PBANC_STEP_CD = 'PP030' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS assignWait, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS020' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS awaitingTeam, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS010' AND RTRN_SE_CD IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS returned, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN TRCK_STTS_CD = 'TR010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS tracking FROM TB_BID_PBANC

SELECT
WHERE (P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS010' AND P.PBANC_STEP_CD = 'PP030') OR P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS020' ORDER BY P.BID_DDLN_DT, P.PBANC_SN FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS020' AND P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN = ) AS decisionWait, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040') AND ) AS inProgress, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RQT_MTTR Q JOIN TB_BID_PBANC P ON P.PBANC_SN = Q.PBANC_SN WHERE Q.TOC_SN IS NULL AND P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040') AND ) AS unmapped, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040') AND AND TRUNC(P.BID_DDLN_DT) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN 0 AND 7) AS dueSoon FROM DUAL

SELECT
WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS020' AND P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN = ORDER BY P.BID_DDLN_DT, P.PBANC_SN FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT
WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040', 'PS050') AND ORDER BY P.BID_DDLN_DT, P.PBANC_SN FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, T.TOC_NO AS tocNo, T.TOC_NM AS tocNm, T.EXPC_PAGE_CNT AS expcPageCnt, C.CD_NM AS tocStatusNm, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F WHERE F.TOC_SN = T.TOC_SN) AS fileCnt, TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ddlnText, TRUNC(P.BID_DDLN_DT) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS dday FROM TB_TOC T JOIN TB_BID_PBANC P ON P.PBANC_SN = T.PBANC_SN LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'TOCST' AND C.CD = T.PRGRS_STTS_CD WHERE T.PIC_ID = #{userId} AND P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040') ORDER BY P.BID_DDLN_DT, P.PBANC_SN, T.SORT_SEQ FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY

SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, TM.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SBMSN_DCMNT D WHERE D.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN) AS docTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SBMSN_DCMNT D WHERE D.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND D.PRGRS_STTS_CD = 'DS030') AS docReady, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SBMSN_DCMNT D WHERE D.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND D.ESNTL_YN = 'Y' AND D.PRGRS_STTS_CD <> 'DS030') AS missingRequired, CASE WHEN P.SBMSN_DT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS registered FROM TB_BID_PBANC P LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM TM ON TM.TEAM_SN = P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040') ORDER BY P.BID_DDLN_DT, P.PBANC_SN FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BID_PBANC WHERE PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS050'

SELECT TM.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS020' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS assigned, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inProgress, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS050' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS submitted, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS060' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS resulted FROM TB_TEAM TM LEFT JOIN TB_BID_PBANC P ON P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN = TM.TEAM_SN WHERE TM.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND TM.TEAM_SN = (SELECT U.TEAM_SN FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId})
AND TM.DEPT_CD = 'DP030'
GROUP BY TM.TEAM_SN, TM.TEAM_NM ORDER BY TM.TEAM_SN
